svg.desc: Two Gantt charts of four batch slots over fourteen decode steps. With static batching the first batch runs until its longest sequence ends at step 9, leaving many idle padding cells, and all eight requests finish at step 14. With continuous batching a waiting request takes a slot the step it frees, and the same eight requests finish at step 10.
